Building a safe foods list

A safe foods list is every food your child will eat without a fight, written down in one place.

Start by logging what was eaten at each meal for a week. EatPal sorts the log by texture and color so the patterns show up on their own.

Why texture comes first

Most picky eaters accept a narrow band of textures. Knowing the band tells you which new food is one small step away.

  • Crunchy and dry
  • Smooth and cold
